notes: ὁ οὐράνιος rendered attributively as heavenly, so the second article is unrepresented under rule 23 rather than taking a supplied relativizer; rule 31 is not in question, the ASV writing no relative clause.
The first article is emptied by rule 20 displacement from ὑμῶν.
ὡς keeps a bare as: no correlative καί stands, so rules 82 and 100 do not arise.
